Edge AI & Computer Vision Intern
description:
We are investigating real-time edge computing architectures to enhance visual feedback in next-generation medical robotics. Our systems combine high-bandwidth video streams with real-time robotic telemetry to support precision tasks.

In this internship, you will lead the hands-on prototyping of an edge AI processing unit using a state-of-the-art Edge AI development platform. You will be responsible for bringing up the hardware from scratch, establishing a low-latency video pass-through pipeline, and evaluating how computer vision and machine learning models can extract insights and render helpful visual cues in real time.

Tasks:

• Hardware Bring-Up: Set up, configure, and benchmark a new edge AI development platform (operating system, drivers, hardware acceleration libraries, and high-speed video capture interfaces).

• Low-Latency Video Pipeline: Explore and prototype low-latency video streaming architectures using real-time processing frameworks to capture high-resolution camera feeds and drive responsive external displays.

• Telemetry & Visual Overlays: Ingest robotic telemetry alongside the video feed to render dynamic graphical annotations and spatial guidance cues directly onto the live stream.

• Computer Vision & AI Prototyping: Benchmark lightweight computer vision algorithms and modern neural network architectures (e.g., for object tracking, state awareness, or semantic scene understanding) on edge hardware.

• System Profiling & Documentation: Measure end-to-end processing delays, evaluate hardware resource utilization, and document the architecture to guide future product development.

Requirements

Required abilities:

• Enrolled in a Master’s degree or final year of a Bachelor’s program in Computer Science, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Practical programming experience in Python or C++.

• Working knowledge of Linux environments, shell scripting, and version control (Git).

• Foundational understanding of computer vision or machine learning using standard libraries (such as OpenCV, PyTorch, or ONNX Runtime).

• An exploratory, hands-on mindset with an interest in hardware bring-up, lab prototyping, and embedded development.

• Open-minded, self-driven & creative problem solving

• Fluency in English is a must

Beneficial Experience:

• Familiarity with real-time streaming SDKs (e.g., NVIDIA Holoscan, DeepStream, or GStreamer) or GPU acceleration tools (CUDA, TensorRT).

• Basic understanding of sensor fusion or 2D/3D coordinate transformations.

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . title: Bybit: Business Development Assistant

Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance. Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role *Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across EU and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on community building, merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels. The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth. Key Responsibilities: • Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across EU, building and owning the full growth pipeline • Acquire and manage merchants, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels. • Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution. • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases. • Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows. • Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations. • Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction. • Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships. Requirements: • 1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD. • Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have). • Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs. • Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets. • Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. • Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills. • Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred. Preferred Qualifications • Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement. • Background working in global remote teams. • Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-business-development-assistant

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: AI Security Researcher
description:
About the Role



As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats—model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection—and translating them into practical security defenses.

You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adversarial Threat Research: Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis: Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle—from data ingestion to deployment—to prioritize security investments.
  • Developing Defenses & Guardrails: Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats.
  • Collaborating with Engineering Teams: Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public.
  • Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends: Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research.

Requirements

  • University degree in AI/ML or relevant discipline.
  • Current residence in Germany or Austria.
  • Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only.

title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
description:
Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy. Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house. La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave.

Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business.

Principali responsabilità:

  • sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365, con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale
  • supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti
  • partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali, contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business
  • seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico, collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale
  • garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni


Requisiti richiesti:

  • conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps
  • competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python, e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne
  • conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati, con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali
  • capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici


Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali:

  • laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente
  • esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365
  • esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
  • familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
  • esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
  • approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
  • capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi


Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on, autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo.

In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso.
